title: Computational aberration-retrieval with entangled photons
summary: Adaptive optics (AO) is central to high-resolution microscopy, yet conventional implementations often require repeated correction-and-measurement cycles whose number increases with aberration complexity. This measurement burden can become prohibitive when the available temporal window for correction is short or when photon budgets are constrained. Here, we demonstrate an AO strategy that exploits the spatial correlations of entangled photon pairs to retrieve aberrations directly.
